name: Bar Compliance Content Reviewer
description: Reviews legal marketing copy against attorney advertising rules. Layer 1 regex catches banned terms; Layer 2 LLM catches implied violations. Routes by confidence and reports its own accuracy.

  if (!cfg) throw new Error('Unknown client_id: ' + row.client_id);

    json: {

      content: row.content,
      client_id: row.client_id,

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-sonnet-5", max_tokens: 1200, messages: [ { role: "user", content: $json.llm_prompt } ] }) }}

parameters.content:
## Two-layer review

Layer 1 catches unambiguous violations with regex: best, #1, specialist, guarantee, results without a disclaimer, NY labeling. Free, instant, cannot hallucinate.

Layer 2 catches what regex structurally cannot, such as "get the compensation you deserve" - an implied guarantee with no banned word.

Disclaimers are stripped before scanning, because the compliant disclaimer itself contains the word "guarantee".

## Measured, not assumed

Ground truth for 40 documents is carried through the pipeline and compared here.

The headline is the **silent error rate**: of the copy that went out without review (PASS and PASS_WITH_NOTES), the share that needed a person. A note is not a catch; the copy still went out.

Beside it, the **false alarm rate**: clean copy sent to a person. A reviewer that flags everything gets ignored in a week, and then it protects nobody.

## Pass-with-notes log

PASS_WITH_NOTES copy goes live without a person, so its notes are written to the data table **Compliance Reviewer: Pass-with-Notes Log**, one row per note.

Sort by `code` to see which problems keep coming back; `short_by` is how far the finding fell below the client's threshold. `source` separates eval-set runs from live copy.
